title: Firebird Trace Analyzer — keyboard shortcut overrides
description: Overrides for keyboard shortcuts. Stored as %AppData%/FirebirdTraceAnalyzer/shortcuts.json. Only overrides are stored: a missing entry means the default applies; a null value means the action is explicitly disabled. Actions are 'App.*'/'Search.*' (core), 'Report.Run:<templateId>' (reports). Gesture format: modifiers and key joined with '+', e.g. 'Primary+Shift+O'. Primary resolves to Ctrl on Windows/Linux and Cmd on macOS. Recognized modifier tokens: Primary, Ctrl, Shift, Alt (also accepted: Meta/Cmd/Win, normalized to Primary). Key is an Avalonia Key enum name (O, D1, Escape, OemComma, F5, ...). The file is applied at application start; deleting the file resets everything to defaults.

oneOf.description: Gesture: Primary|Ctrl|Shift|Alt (+ ...) + Key (Avalonia Key enum name), e.g. 'Primary+O', 'Primary+Shift+R', 'Ctrl+OemComma', 'Primary+F5'.
